about: Made by .github/desktop/ai/make_pano_golden.py, whose header describes pano-v1 and relief-360-v1. Images are rows of R, G, B bytes; masks are rows of 0 and 1 (inside: the photo; holes: a filled pixel).

projections.name: landscape
projections.description: a 4:3 photo of 60° across, pasted back at a larger size

projections.name: portrait
projections.description: a 3:4 photo of 40° across, pasted back at the size of the frame

reliefs.name: production
reliefs.description: the shift of the app, 1° at the equator: no hole on such a small frame

reliefs.name: strong
reliefs.description: a shift of 30° that opens holes beside the object, across the seam
